description: Apply one action (mark read or unread, star, unstar, archive or delete) to many Inbox conversations at once. Only affects your own inbox. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

conversation_ids.description: Inbox conversation IDs (numeric strings) from list_conversations.

event.description: Action to apply to every listed conversation. "destroy" deletes them from your inbox for good.

name: batch_update_conversations
title: Batch Update Conversations
